# Sats402

> SDK and protocol for x402 pay-per-request payments in native sats on Tachi.
> An agent pays per call by signing its own transaction; the service verifies by
> reading the chain. No accounts, no API keys, no custodian.

This file is a brief for AI agents visiting this site. Everything here is
checkable: settlements are Tachi transaction ids anyone can re-fetch.

## Services agents can buy (sats per call)

- BTC market price feed: GET /api/services/price (5 sats) — live BTC/USD with 24h change
- Bitcoin fee estimates: GET /api/services/fees (5 sats) — live next-block fee ladder
- Tachi network state: GET /api/services/network (5 sats) — ledger fee, epoch height
- Grounded AI completion: POST /api/services/inference (50 sats) — model answer
  grounded in live data the service buys itself first
- Protected market brief: GET /api/protected (5 sats) — rendered HTML, pay-per-view

Machine-readable catalog: /services.json
OpenAPI 3.1 contract: /openapi.json

## How to pay (x402, three requests)

1. Call the endpoint. On 402, read the challenge from the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header.
2. Settle: sign and broadcast a Tachi transaction (tachi_tx) for exactly the
   price, to the payee owner key in the challenge.
3. Retry with the payment proof in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. The response carries
   PAYMENT-RESPONSE with the settlement id.

The SDK does all three and enforces a spending policy (per-call cap, session
budget, payee allowlist): @sats402/agent for clients, @sats402/express for
services.

## Verifying anything

- GET /receipt/<txid> — read-only daemon record (state, epoch, outputs, inputs)
- POST /api/verify-payment with a payment payload — runs every check live
- CLI: npx sats402 verify <txid>

Protocol binding (normative):
https://github.com/Johnenyen/Sats402/blob/main/specs/schemes/exact/scheme_exact_tachi.md

Scope note: this deployment settles on Tachi regtest (tachi-regtest-1), the
network whose write path is open today. Signet is the same code with a
different base URL and network name.
